VALIDATION_ERROR.rule: On LinkedIn Easy Apply multi-page forms, click the Review button once all required questions on the current page are filled out to move to the final submission page.

MODAL_OVERLAY.rule: On LinkedIn Easy Apply flows, job alert creation notices may pop up but can be ignored or bypassed by clicking the primary navigation buttons like Review or Submit.

MISSING_ACTION_BUTTON.rule: On LinkedIn Easy Apply forms, once all mandatory text fields and questions on the additional questions pages are filled, click the Review button to proceed to the final submission step.

DYNAMIC_QUESTION.rule: On LinkedIn Easy Apply, when additional mandatory questions are completed and the Review button appears, click Review to proceed to the final application step.
